name: Windward
description: WINDWARD - The Age of Air. A portrait mobile tower-defense/strategy prototype in three.js: bind the wind into roads, defy Poseidon, survive nine tides and his wrath. Genetically-evolved AI opponent with a live temper, self-playing demo, fully offline. Prompt-built with AI for the Meta Horizon Creator Competition.

paragraphs: A portrait mobile web prototype for the Meta Horizon Creator Competition (Tower Defense & Strategy).
▶ Play the current build: (open on a phone, or a narrow browser window)

One road, five jobs. A single system carries the whole game — the bound road. It is movement (everything rides it), income (islands it touches are mined; haulers must land the ore), reach (only the road lifts the fog and grants ground), attack surface (roads are invulnerable along their length — the raw ends and capping towers are the joints), and drama (a severed branch visibly unbinds segment by segment while you race to reconnect it).
